system.description:
OF JUSTICE

PARTY, REPUTABLE, IDEALISTIC PARTY TENSION METER All party members suffer 1 fatigue All party members suffer 2 str and 2 fatigue, then tension resets FORTUNE to zero X POOL RIGHT WINGS MADE of this party may suffer stress and 1 fatigue to add {Df} damage to a Ranged Attack or Melee Attack action. They may choose to do this after the roll, and may use ability more than once with each attack.
